messages:
alex: @maria quick q — flying to Berlin for conference 4/20-4/24. Is there a way to get per‑diem advanced or do I need to submit expenses after the trip? Also the hotel will be booked on my personal card because our corporate card is tied up. what’s the process? :airplane:

maria - People Ops: hey @alex :wave: you can request up to 50% of estimated per‑diem in advance with manager approval + People Ops signoff. remainder is reconciled after filing expenses. please open a travel advance request in the Travel form (link in #people-ops-policies).

alex: thanks — do we need receipts for meals if using per‑diem? and what about public transit receipts? :receipt:

maria - People Ops: good q. per‑diem covers meals up to the daily cap, so no meal receipts required for amounts within per‑diem. keep local transit receipts (U-Bahn, taxis) if you want reimbursement outside per‑diem (e.g., airport transfers). If a receipt is lost, you can attach a short memo explaining — finance will accept a signed missing-receipt memo for items under $75.

dan (Finance): adding: since you’re booking on a personal card, make sure to tag the charge with `Project: PROJ-42` and submit the receipt within 14 days. if you want a direct charge to Redwood, ping procurement and we can try virtual card for the vendor. Upload to Ramp and select expense type `Travel - Lodging`. :card_file_box:

alex: how long does the advance take? flight is booked next week and i don’t want to front everything.

maria - People Ops: advances typically process within 3 business days after approvals. please include an itemized estimate (flight + hotel + per‑diem days) in the travel advance form. if it’s urgent, mention "expedite" in the request and cc your manager — we’ll push to finance-bot for faster routing.

finance-bot: Automated: Travel advance request submitted without manager approval will be blocked. Missing manager approval: Notify manager or add an approving comment.

jess: fwiw — when i did this for SF last month, Finance cleared reimbursement in ~10 business days after i submitted everything in Ramp. keep all receipts in one upload and mention the advance amount so they net it out.

alex: perfect — will submit now. tagging @maria if anything else pops up. :thumbsup:
